photo.caption: The then US Secretary of Defense Donald Rumsfeld meeting with President Andrés Pastrana.
photo.description: Secretary of Defense Donald H. Rumsfeld (left) talks with Colombian President Andres Pastrana (right) at the conclusion of their Pentagon meeting on Feb. 26, 2001. The two men met to discuss a range of regional issues of interest to both nations. DoD photo by R. D. Ward. (Released)
